datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 45.3 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 41% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 1 year, 4 months ( Last edited 4 months ago ) and 58% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Curaçao through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 41% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with 58% of features added or updated within the last 6 months as of the export date.
